Name: Mod Manager Download - JuniGrid
Author: MLD210
Description:
[size=5][b]JuniGrid — a launcher and mod manager for Stardew Valley[/b][/size]

JuniGrid is a Windows desktop app that covers the whole loop in one place: find a mod on Nexus, install it,
keep it up to date, know when it is no longer maintained, and launch the game — without hand-editing folders.
It is bilingual (English / Chinese) and ships seven accent themes.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53227/53227-1790868364-1022521073.png[/img]

[line]
[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Nexus sign-in (OAuth)[/b] — log in with your own Nexus Mods account. No API key to request, paste or
rotate. Browse and search Nexus inside the app, and one-click the [i]Download[/i] button on a mod page hands
the install straight to JuniGrid.[/*]
[*][b]Install, update, roll back[/b] — mods land in the right folder, sub-packages of a bundle are handled as
part of their parent, and the update check compares against the file you actually installed (file ID + version),
not just the number in the manifest.[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53227/53227-1790868385-1421345016.png[/img][/*]
[*][b]Maintenance status you can trust[/b] — mods the community compatibility list flags are marked, and the
badge takes you to the [b]real[/b] alternative build instead of back to the page you already have. If you are
already running the recommended build, it says so plainly ("unofficial successor" / "no longer maintained")
rather than nagging you.[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53227/53227-1790868403-468732088.png[/img][/*]
[*][b]Dependency handling[/b] — missing dependencies are detected and offered in one click, sub-modules of the
same package are not mistaken for separate mods, and a dependency that is installed but [i]disabled[/i] gets its
own notice, because SMAPI will still skip the mod that needs it.[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53227/53227-1790868436-283591026.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53227/53227-1790868446-1478321151.png[/img][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] — install or update SMAPI from within the app (it fetches the official installer from Nexus),
or launch in vanilla mode. A command box sends console commands straight to the running game.[/*]
[*][b]Portrait tools[/b] — build and switch NPC portrait packs, season-aware, with the game's own body sheets
respected rather than stretched.[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53227/53227-1790868472-291586026.png[/img][/*]
[*][b]Translation overlays[/b] — install a language pack over an existing mod as a switchable overlay: each
replaced file is backed up first, and you can toggle or restore individual files instead of reinstalling.[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53227/53227-1790868494-572385234.png[/img][/*]
[*][b]Launch & troubleshoot[/b] — one-click start, live log view, save and mod-list backups.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Getting started[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download the installer, run it, point it at your Stardew Valley folder (it also finds Steam / GOG installs).[/*]
[*]Open [b]Nexus[/b] and sign in with your Nexus Mods account.[/*]
[*]On the [b]Mods[/b] page, install SMAPI if you have not already.[/*]
[*]Browse or search, hit install, then [b]Launch[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Windows x64 (10 / 11). The installer is self-contained — no .NET pre-install step.[/*]
[*]A Nexus Mods account, for sign-in and for downloading mods you do not own.[/*]
[*]如果你想在游戏中加载模组，需要星露谷物语 1.6 和 SMAPI。[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]它如何与Nexus通信[/b][/size]
已注册的应用程序，仅支持 OAuth 认证——它绝不会请求或存储个人 API 密钥。它使用公共 API。
遵守速率限制标头，在每次请求中都使用自己的应用程序名称和版本进行标识。
它会遵循您帐户的成人内容设置，而不是绕过它。它不会抓取网页。

[spoiler]
JuniGrid 捆绑了以下内容，每个内容均未修改：
[list]
[*][b]DepotDownloader[/b] — GNU GPL v2。许可证文本包含在软件包中
（tools/DepotDownloader/LICENSE）；完整的源代码可在 github.com/SteamRE/DepotDownloader 获取。[/*]
[*][b]Microsoft Edge WebView2 运行时引导程序[/b]和[b]Microsoft XNA Framework 4.0 可再发行组件包[/b]—
根据 Microsoft 各自的条款重新分发。[/*]
[*][b].NET 运行时[/b]（自包含，MIT）。[/*]
[/list]SMAPI 和任何模组都是在运行时从 Nexus 下载的——它们不属于此软件包的一部分。[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]来源和版本[/b][/size]
开发过程、发布说明和源代码：[url=https://github.com/MLD-yu/JuniGrid]github.com/MLD-yu/JuniGrid[/url]

[size=4][b]笔记[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]JuniGrid 管理文件，它本身并不修改游戏。它只会
在需要时将 SMAPI 安装到游戏文件夹中。[/*]
[*]翻译叠加层始终会保留每个文件的备份，卸载宿主模组后即可清理这些备份。[/*]
[*]欢迎在上面的 GitHub 页面上提出反馈和问题。[/*]
[/list]
